# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- Provenance schema implemented in crates/tank_core/src/types/provenance.rs with ConfidenceLevel enum (Literature, Expert, Heuristic, Placeholder), ParamMeta struct (unit, source, confidence, valid_range, notes — all optional), RangeWarning struct, check_param_range(), check_all_ranges(), and format_param() functions.
- All types publicly exported via tank_core::types::mod.rs (line 47-49) and re-exported via tank_data::lib.rs (lines 11-13) for external consumption.
- ProcessParamsPreset in tank_data/src/presets.rs carries both preset-level Provenance (source_title, source_year, confidence, notes) and per-parameter BTreeMap<String, ParamMeta> with #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if)] for backward compatibility.
- ParamMeta uses #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] to catch typos in metadata fields. ProcessParamsPreset::validate() rejects unknown param_meta keys via unknown_param_meta_keys() + param_value() lookup against all 56 parameters.
- check_ranges() method on ProcessParamsPreset produces Vec<RangeWarning> (informational, not load failure) by delegating to check_all_ranges() — meeting the 'warning not error' requirement.
- format_param() produces developer-facing output like 'K_s_aob: 0.5 mg N/L [literature, EPA 2013] range [0.1, 5.0] notes: biofilter context' — satisfying the display helper requirement.
- All 6 required acceptance-criteria tests present and passing: test_provenance_schema_roundtrip (AC1), test_provenance_optional_fields (AC2), test_confidence_levels_enum (AC3), test_valid_range_enforcement (AC4), test_backward_compatible_loading (AC5), test_provenance_display (AC6), plus test_unknown_param_meta_keys_are_rejected as a bonus guard.
- 9 provenance unit tests pass in tank_core (--lib provenance), 13 tests pass in tank_data (--lib), and 50 integration tests pass across budget_tracking/budget_helpers/shrimp_population.
- SUB_ADULT_FEEDING_WEIGHT constant consolidated to single definition (0.67) in biology.rs, imported by shrimp.rs — no more divergent values.
- RemoveShrimp reserve fraction now uses adults_before_removal as denominator instead of total_count(), fixing the dilution bug.
- load_process_params() in lib.rs calls preset.validate() which now includes unknown param_meta key rejection, completing the data loading integration.

## Findings and Gaps

- No TOML data files currently contain [param_meta.*] sections — the infrastructure is ready but no parameters have provenance metadata attached yet. This is expected for this bead; actual metadata attachment is the deliverable of tanksim-6e5.7.2 (the downstream dependent).
- Preset-level Provenance.confidence is typed as Option<String> rather than Option<ConfidenceLevel> enum, creating a minor inconsistency between preset-level and parameter-level confidence typing. Not a blocker since they serve different granularity levels, but worth noting for future alignment.
- The schema currently only supports per-parameter provenance on ProcessParamsPreset. Other preset types (SourceWater, Substrate, Plant, Shrimp, Scenario) have preset-level Provenance but not per-parameter ParamMeta. This is acceptable for the current scope since process parameters are the highest-value target.

## Follow-up and Amendments

None.
